testcase.name: a level 1, unequipped, un-prayed attacker deals the minimum baseline hit

ranged strength equipment bonus (BonusSlot RANGED_STRENGTH_BONUS) composes into max hit

protect from missiles only zeroes accuracy against a non-player attacker

Rigour's ranged strength prayer multiplier composes into effective Ranged
